name: LEFT SIDE LYING FORWARD LEG LIFT
introduce:
Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left arm. 

Bend your knees at a 90 degree angle in front of you.

Straighten your right leg and raise it straight up and down.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your lifted leg straight.
Please keep your lifted leg perpendicular to your body.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
You should feel your glutes engage.
If you cannot feel your glutes engage, please rotate your hips slightly forward.
Please try to keep your toes facing downward.
